targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS configured_instance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_data->>'server_address', '') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE tag_data->>'server_address' || COALESCE(':' || NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_port', ''), '') END AS server_endpoint, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'pg_version', ''), 'unknown') AS postgres_version FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS configured_instance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_data->>'server_address', '') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE tag_data->>'server_address' || COALESCE(':' || NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_port', ''), '') END AS server_endpoint, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'pg_version', ''), 'unknown') AS postgres_version FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$target' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (data->>'subscription_status')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'active')::int AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (data->>'apply_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (data->>'table_sync_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT time AS time, (data->>'lag_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'apply_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'sync_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

WITH latest_subscription AS (SELECT tag_data->>'publications' AS publications FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), wanted AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(publications, '[]')::jsonb) AS publication FROM latest_subscription), latest_publications AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'publication') time, tag_data, data FROM source_publication WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'publication', time DESC) SELECT wanted.publication, CASE WHEN publication.tag_data IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'CONFIGURED' END AS status, publication.tag_data->>'owner' AS owner, COALESCE((publication.data->>'table_count')::bigint, 0) AS tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'all_tables')::int, 0) AS all_tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_insert')::int, 0) AS inserts, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_update')::int, 0) AS updates, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_delete')::int, 0) AS deletes, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_truncate')::int, 0) AS truncates FROM wanted LEFT JOIN latest_publications AS publication ON publication.tag_data->>'publication' = wanted.publication ORDER BY wanted.publication

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND tag_data->>'worker_type' = 'apply' ORDER BY time

SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'slot_name') time, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot_name, tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'active')::int AS active, data->>'restart_lsn' AS restart_lsn, data->>'confirmed_flush_lsn' AS confirmed_flush_lsn, (data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint AS lag_bytes, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::bigint AS retained_wal_bytes, tag_data->>'wal_status' AS wal_status, data->>'safe_wal_size_bytes' AS safe_wal_size_bytes, tag_data->>'invalidation_reason' AS invalidation_reason, tag_data->>'replication_application' AS application, tag_data->>'replication_client_addr' AS client_addr, tag_data->>'replication_state' AS replication_state, (data->>'replication_pid')::bigint AS replication_pid, data->>'sent_lsn' AS sent_lsn, data->>'write_lsn' AS write_lsn, data->>'flush_lsn' AS flush_lsn, data->>'replay_lsn' AS replay_lsn FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'slot_name', time DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'worker_type' AS worker_type, (data->>'pid')::bigint AS pid, (data->>'leader_pid')::bigint AS leader_pid, tag_data->>'relation' AS relation, data->>'received_lsn' AS received_lsn, data->>'latest_end_lsn' AS latest_end_lsn, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_send_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_send_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_receipt_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_receipt_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'latest_end_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS latest_end_time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS message_age_seconds FROM target_subscription s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY worker_type, pid

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table') time, tag_data, data FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table', time DESC) SELECT time, tag_data->>'schema' AS schema, tag_data->>'table' AS table, CASE WHEN (data->>'ready')::int = 1 THEN 'READY' ELSE upper(data->>'state_name') END AS status, data->>'synchronization_lsn' AS synchronization_lsn FROM latest ORDER BY status, schema, table

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_replication_origins WHERE dbname = '$target' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'origin' AS origin, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, (data->>'active')::int AS active_inferred, data->>'remote_lsn' AS remote_lsn, data->>'local_lsn' AS local_lsn, (data->>'origin_count')::bigint AS origin_count, (data->>'active_origin_count')::bigint AS active_origin_count FROM target_replication_origins s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$target' ORDER BY origin

SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'database_size_bytes')::bigint AS database_size FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'database_size_bytes')::bigint AS database_size FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$target' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Replication health
panels.description: HEALTHY requires fresh active/streaming slot data, a running apply worker, all tables ready, zero lag, and no new apply/sync errors in five minutes.

targets.rawSql: WITH slot_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS active, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS streaming, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), subscription_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS enabled, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS subscription_status, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS apply_workers FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_points AS (SELECT time, COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors, COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors, COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_changes AS (SELECT time, reset_epoch, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0) + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (ORDER BY time)), error_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors, COALESCE(min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch), false) AS reset_stable FROM error_changes), table_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes') SELECT CASE WHEN s.latest IS NULL OR sub.latest IS NULL OR e.latest IS NULL OR t.latest IS NULL OR s.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR sub.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR e.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR t.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 3 WHEN s.active <> 1 OR s.streaming < 1 OR sub.enabled <> 1 OR sub.subscription_status <> 1 OR sub.apply_workers < 1 OR t.total_tables < 1 OR t.non_ready_tables > 0 OR e.new_errors > 5 THEN 2 WHEN s.lag_bytes > 0 OR e.new_errors > 0 OR NOT e.reset_stable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS health, e.new_errors AS errors_last_5m FROM slot_state s CROSS JOIN subscription_state sub CROSS JOIN error_state e CROSS JOIN table_state t

panels.title: Cutover status
panels.description: READY requires healthy synchronized replication, zero new errors, all tables ready, and the latest exact data comparison to pass.

targets.rawSql: WITH slot_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS active, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS streaming, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), subscription_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS enabled, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS subscription_status, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS apply_workers FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_points AS (SELECT time, COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors, COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors, COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_changes AS (SELECT time, reset_epoch, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0) + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (ORDER BY time)), error_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors, COALESCE(min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch), false) AS reset_stable FROM error_changes), table_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), pair_state AS (SELECT tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), validation_state AS (SELECT status FROM cutover_validation WHERE migration_pair = (SELECT migration_pair FROM pair_state) ORDER BY validated_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN s.latest IS NULL OR sub.latest IS NULL OR e.latest IS NULL OR t.latest IS NULL OR s.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR sub.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR e.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR t.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 4 WHEN s.active <> 1 OR s.streaming < 1 OR sub.enabled <> 1 OR sub.subscription_status <> 1 OR sub.apply_workers < 1 OR t.total_tables < 1 OR t.non_ready_tables > 0 OR e.new_errors > 5 THEN 2 WHEN s.lag_bytes > 0 OR e.new_errors > 0 OR NOT e.reset_stable THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT status FROM validation_state) IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT status FROM validation_state) <> 'PASS' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS cutover_status FROM slot_state s CROSS JOIN subscription_state sub CROSS JOIN error_state e CROSS JOIN table_state t

SELECT tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, (data->>'ready_tables')::bigint AS ready_tables, (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint AS non_ready_tables, (data->>'total_tables')::bigint AS total_tables, CASE WHEN (data->>'total_tables')::bigint > 0 AND (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint = 0 THEN 'READY' ELSE 'NOT READY' END AS status, time AS sampled_at FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

list.label: Source
list.name: source
list.query: SELECT database || ' — ' || endpoint AS __text, profile AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname) dbname AS profile, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'database', ''), dbname) AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_address', ''), NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS endpoint FROM general_database WHERE tag_data->>'migration_role' = 'publisher' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY dbname, time DESC) AS latest ORDER BY database, endpoint

list.label: Target
list.name: target
list.query: SELECT database || ' — ' || endpoint AS __text, profile AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname) dbname AS profile, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'database', ''), dbname) AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_address', ''), NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS endpoint FROM general_database WHERE tag_data->>'migration_role' = 'subscriber' AND tag_data->>'migration_pair' = (SELECT tag_data->>'migration_pair' FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY dbname, time DESC) AS latest ORDER BY database, endpoint

list.label: Slot
list.name: slot
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __text, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY 1

list.label: Subscription
list.name: subscription
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'subscription' AS __text, tag_data->>'subscription' AS __value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY 1
